page: Google Cloud Platform n4a-highmem-32 is an Arm-based virtual machine instance belonging to the n4a server family. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs built on the arm64 architecture, paired with 256.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU, aligning it with memory-optimized resource profiles.

This instance does not include local NVMe SSD storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core or burstable environments.

Utilizing the arm64 architecture generally provides high resource density and power efficiency, translating to qualitative cost advantages for memory-intensive workloads compared to traditional x86 architectures. The n4a-highmem-32 is designed for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity relative to compute power, such as medium-sized databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise applications, and memory-bound data processing tasks.
